verdict.rationale: Brex's API surface (transactions, expenses, budgets) allows programmatic read access to some data, but there is no documented bulk/full data export tool, open-format data dump, or account-portability feature to 'take your data and leave'. missing for 10: a documented full-account export/download feature, open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export tool, or explicit data-portability/account-closure export policy.
